questions.question: What makes your clinic different?
questions.answer: Mino Pimatisiwin means 'the good life.' We believe all people deserve access to culturally safe health care so they can live a good life.

questions.question: What types of testing is available at the clinic?
questions.answer: First, we’ll ask about any specific symptoms or concerns that brought you to the clinic. Next, we’ll decide where we go from there with you. Testing is typically available for HIV, Hep B and C, syphilis, chlamydia, gonorrhea, bacterial vaginosis and trichomoniasis. We also have pregnancy tests.

questions.question: Do you provide traditional medicines?
questions.answer: We have traditional medicines available, and our [Knowledge Keepers, Elders, grandmothers and aunties… ] are there to provide guidance in traditional healing.

questions.question: What happens when someone comes to the clinic for the first time?
questions.answer: That’s totally up to you! We’ll talk about why you stopped by and take things one step at a time.

questions.question: Should I bring my partner?
questions.answer: We’d love to meet them, too. Make it a date!
